source.title: Array-Agnostic Ambisonics Encoding via Diffusion Posterior Sampling

verification.method: All 140 printed values cross-checked between versioned HTML and PDF text; values transcribed without re-estimation.
verification.table3_note: PDF confirms SI-SDR 6.63 and 6.16; the apparent leading zeros in HTML are formatting placeholders.
verification.table2_note: Param., 5 Mics, ILD error is 2.54 dB in both HTML and PDF; retained as printed.

source.changes: Numeric tables transcribed to structured JSON; labels translated and definitions, source links, and comparison limitations added. No affiliation or endorsement implied.

metrics.label: SI-SDR
metrics.definition: Scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio: alpha = dot(reference, estimate) / dot(reference, reference); target = alpha * reference; score = 10 log10(sum(target^2) / sum((estimate - target)^2)). This projects the estimate onto the reference direction.
metrics.limitations: ADEPS does not fully state mean removal, per-channel aggregation, signal length, alignment, or silence handling. This is not NRMSE or absolute-level accuracy.

metrics.label: Mean magnitude spectrum error
metrics.limitations: Gen-A defines each frequency over time and channels. ADEPS does not fully specify table frequency/scene aggregation, valid-bin selection, amplitude floor, or silent-bin handling.

metrics.label: Magnitude-squared coherence
metrics.label_jp: 振幅二乗コヒーレンス
metrics.definition: C(f) = mean_c abs(sum_t conj(b[t,f,c]) * bhat[t,f,c])^2 / (sum_t abs(b[t,f,c])^2 * sum_t abs(bhat[t,f,c])^2). The division occurs per channel before channel averaging.
metrics.limitations: Zero denominators and table aggregation are not fully specified. Constant gain or phase rotation can preserve coherence; this metric alone does not establish complete spatial accuracy.

metrics.label: ILD error
metrics.label_jp: 両耳間レベル差の誤差
metrics.definition: Mean absolute error of interaural level differences after binaural rendering using Neumann KU100 HRTFs and ERB bands.
metrics.limitations: Exact HRTF selection, rendering, ERB filters, time/frequency averaging, and numeric safeguards are not fully specified in ADEPS.

metrics.label: IC error
metrics.label_jp: 両耳間コヒーレンスの誤差
metrics.definition: Mean absolute error of interaural coherence cues after the specified binaural rendering and ERB-band analysis.
metrics.limitations: This is binaural interaural-coherence error, distinct from coefficient magnitude-squared coherence. Windowing, lag search, and aggregation are not fully specified in ADEPS.

arrays.label: 4 Mics
arrays.geometry: Random irregular; Table 3 selects a single fixed geometry.

arrays.label: Aria
arrays.note: ADEPS Section 4 names the device but does not enumerate the channels used or publish its response matrix; no channel count is inferred here.

methods.label: Param.
methods.description: Parametric resynthesis supplied with oracle source directions and device array transfer functions; an oracle-aided comparator.

methods.label: U-Net
methods.description: Array-specific encoder trained for the one 4-microphone geometry in Table 3.

methods.label: Diff-Enc.
methods.description: Array-specific diffusion encoder with channel-concatenation conditioning, trained for the Table 3 geometry.

methods.label: ADEPS
methods.description: Original authors’ trained, array-independent order-5 prior, conditioned on the array during DPS inference. These published values are not measurements of this application’s independent model.

training.room_response_method: HARP-generated target Ambisonics room impulse responses
training.backbone: NCSN++M extended with changed input/output channels and adaLN noise/time conditioning
training.objective: EDM-preconditioned, noise-weighted squared denoising error, Eq. 12

test.source_sampling: Source count, distance, and arrival direction sampled per scenario; directions uniform as reported. Angular bounds and seeds are not listed.
test.noise: Additive Gaussian, independent across microphones in the signal model
test.note: 13,000 is the paper’s reported scene-by-array count, not the number of independent speech scenes. The paper does not separately give a Table 3 signal count or a combined count over both N_eff settings.

inference.initialization: Gaussian perturbation around compressed linear encoding, Algorithm 1
inference.guidance: Likelihood gradient through H(E V H^-1(denoised)), normalized by its norm and sigma
inference.note: The paper does not supply numerical gamma or eta_prime, nor an unambiguous terminal sigma convention.

not_specified_in_paper: Exact train/evaluation scene lists, audio segments, speaker identities, seeds, and split manifest
Sample rate, FFT/hop/window/scaling, chunk length, overlap, and resampling
Complex network channel packing and explicit SH normalization/channel convention
Complete network layer configuration, optimizer, batch size, training steps, and learning-rate schedule
Exact array geometry/ATF files and binaural rendering implementation
Metric floors, zero/silence handling, frequency/scene aggregation, and confidence intervals

frequency_curves.note: Figure 1 is a plot of spectral error and coherence. No numerical curve is transcribed or digitized into this file; do not interpolate table values into frequency curves.

limitations_jp: 論文v3に掲載された参考値です。このアプリの独自モデルやADEPS+αの再計算結果ではありません。
論文はWSJ0の1,000場面と13配置、当アプリの評価は別の音声・場面・配置・処理長を使用しています。値を並べても、同一条件での優劣や論文超えを示すことにはなりません。
評価対象は1次の4係数です。表1は音場5次と事前分布5次が一致、表2・3は音場15次と事前分布5次が不一致です。アプリの5次一致の結果を表2・3と直接比較できません。
論文にはNRMSEの表値や数値の周波数曲線がありません。SI-SDRをNRMSEへ換算したり、図1をアプリの測定値として使ったりしません。
スペクトル誤差とコヒーレンスは引用文献に式がありますが、論文の全帯域平均・無音処理・床値などは十分に特定できません。両耳のILD/IC誤差には別途KU100のHRTFを使うレンダリングが必要です。
ADEPSが全指標で最良ではありません。表3のSI-SDRはDiff-Enc.が9.52 dB、ADEPSが9.23 dB。コヒーレンスはU-Netが0.83、ADEPSが0.71です。
これは合成音場に対する研究評価の参照です。実会場の音、スピーカー補正、長い音楽、聴感上の優位性を保証しません。
limitations_en: These are values published in paper v3, not recomputed results from this application’s independent model or ADEPS+alpha.

The paper uses 1,000 WSJ0 scenes and 13 array realizations. This application evaluates different audio, scenes, geometry, and processing lengths. A side-by-side display is not a controlled comparison or evidence of exceeding the paper.

Evaluation covers four first-order coefficients. Table 1 matches effective and prior orders at 5; Tables 2 and 3 use effective order 15 with prior order 5. This application’s matched-order results cannot be directly compared with the latter.
The paper supplies neither tabulated NRMSE nor numerical frequency curves. SI-SDR must not be converted into NRMSE, and Figure 1 must not be presented as this application’s measurements.

Cited papers define spectral error and coherence, but full-band aggregation, silent-bin treatment, and floors are insufficiently specified in ADEPS. ILD/IC errors additionally require the KU100 binaural renderer.
ADEPS does not lead every metric. In Table 3, Diff-Enc. has SI-SDR 9.52 dB versus ADEPS 9.23 dB; U-Net has coherence 0.83 versus ADEPS 0.71.
These synthetic-field research results do not establish venue performance, loudspeaker correction, long-form music quality, or perceptual superiority.
